metadata.title: Beevil Knievel LoRa PHY Analytical Link Budget
metadata.gateway_radio_hat: Waveshare SX1262 LoRa HAT (Ebyte E22-900T22S, UART)

sources.tx_power: Semtech SX1262 datasheet / E22-900T22S (14 dBm compliant with India WPC GSR 564(E) 865-867 MHz)
sources.tx_antenna: Internal quarter-wave wire whip inside Langstroth wooden frame (2.15 dBi)
sources.tx_feeder_loss: PCB microstrip feed to IPEX connector (0.5 dB)
sources.hive_attenuation: Langstroth pine/cedar supers with wax combs (8.7 dB empirically referenced)
sources.rx_feeder_loss: RG-58 gateway pigtail cable loss (1.0 dB)
sources.fade_margin: 15 dB log-normal shadowing and Rayleigh multi-path margin
sources.two_ray_model: Two-ray ground reflection beyond dc = 72.5 m (ht=0.5 m, hr=4.0 m)
sources.foliage_model: ITU-R P.833 / Weissberger orchard canopy attenuation (50 m foliage path)
